create_mixmodule: create a MixModule that combines multiple nn modules with weighted outputs for neural architecture search
build_create_mix_blocks: build a MixModule from named primitives by calling create_mix_blocks with block names and channel configs
test_mixmodule_forward: test the MixModule forward pass to verify weighted sum of module outputs is computed correctly
review_mixmodule_set_random_path: review the MixModule set_random_path method that zeros weights and activates a single random path
refactor_mixmodule_get_path_count: refactor the MixModule get_path_count method to return the number of registered operations in the module list
